newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Unocal unit signs interim geothermal pact.
newsitem.headline: Unocal unit signs interim geothermal pact.

text.p: Philippine Geothermal Inc (PGI), a unit of Unocal Corp, said on Tuesday it has reached provisional agreement with the National Power Corp to continue operating and maintaining two geothermal fields in the northern Philippines.
A 25-year service contract between Napocor and PGI to operate two 330-megawatt geothermal steamfields expired on Monday.
Napocor and PGI decided to settle on an interim agreement until they have resolved a legal dispute on whether the service contract can be renewed for another 25 years.
The interim contract lasts for six months and can be renewed for another three.
PGI said in a statement that both parties will continue to observe their rights and obligations under the original contract except for the terms of payment.
Under the interim pact, 60 percent of the steam fee will be held in escrow until a decision has been reached by the courts.
